snippet.title: Saturn Longplay [246] Sonic Wings Special (JP)
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: Tsunao

Shmup by Video System.

Something about...some organization causing trouble and many people from countries riding in airplanes to destroy things, from normal things like tanks to a goddamn space monkey. That one is the best boss, btw.

Gameplay involves, well, shooting many things. There's also a bomb button. This game also have branching paths and randomized levels.

This longplay no-skills the game twice: once with Super Sonic Idol Star Mao Mao and then Whity the Dolphin in tate mode.

Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
